bounded_pinned_source_review.reviewer: Independent Astra plus Root refresh-CAS excerpt inspection
findings: Credential mtime reload invalidates caches before the unexpired-token early return, consistent with actual bearer adoption.

Refresh-save mutation preserves stored credentials when the posted refresh token differs from the current nonempty token; the designated empty-token case permits saving. Actual multiprocess race remains untested.
Sibling credentials-change recheck declines while authentication is already valid; broader managed-settings/login refresh is therefore not guaranteed on bearer replacement.
Cached organization/model/bootstrap and billing/role fields have behavioral consumers; some subscription getters instead read current grants.
Inspected organization validators bind cached organization to the access token or resolve the presented token; this does not prove every invocation boundary.
No direct cached-A organization header found in inspected client construction, but composed headers and complete enforcement were not exhaustively traced.
bounded_pinned_source_review.limits: Bounded embedded-source slices, not complete call-graph, live provider acceptance, refresh-race or production qualification.

next_decisive_storage_gate.hypothesis: A cooperating switch waits for the outgoing native refresh, retains the actual refreshed A2 access and refresh tokens, publishes B under compatible native locks, then restores the retained A2 successfully.
next_decisive_storage_gate.architecture: Prioritize a stable shared credential store candidate. Source identifies native OAuth -> legacy OAuth -> storage-write lease order; a storage-only writer neither excludes an in-flight refresh nor preserves late outgoing credentials. Current immutable profiles remain until that writer contract is qualified.
